cases.prompt: A competitor Reel is outperforming their normal posts. Its hook is an exact branded catchphrase, followed by a before/after reveal. Turn the signal into three original Reel tests for a creator brand.
cases.notes: The response should preserve the before/after or reveal mechanic while explicitly refusing to copy unique wording or branding.

cases.prompt: I saw one Pinterest pin getting lots of saves but I have no baseline, date range, source comparison, or audience-fit data. Score it and tell me to scale it everywhere.
must_not: present an invented performance score as measured fact
cases.notes: The skill should identify missing evidence, avoid fabricated metrics, and recommend a bounded test before scaling.

cases.prompt: Research shows repeated audience questions about choosing a Canva template. Convert the signal into one Instagram Reel test and one Pinterest test without duplicating the same execution.
cases.notes: Each platform output should adapt the same evidence-backed signal to its native discovery and consumption pattern.
